# Communication Preferences

<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Goes by:** **Maya** (never "Ms. Ellison," never the full "Maya Ellison" in greetings).
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Tone:** direct, technical, low-ceremony. Skip pleasantries; lead with the answer or the ask.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Format:** bullets over prose; written pre-reads before meetings. Include the "why" and the
  trade-offs, not just status.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Depth:** she can go as deep as the design doc — don't dumb down architecture or incidents.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Escalation:** flag anything that could surprise Daniel or the board **before** it reaches them.
<!-- observed: 2026-07-27 | status: active -->
- **Channels:** Slack for quick, email for anything with an external party, docs for decisions.
